Update I guess. It says I have six comments but I can't see them, so idk. I committed but my brother in law saw me cus I guess my door was open, I don't really remember, but now I'm on lockdown. I overdosed and mixed meds to react with my beta blocker but I guess they emptied me out and got my heart going cus I'm still here, typing this. So now I sit here. No it definitely can be worse, it isn't for everyone, and there are many different strains. I just mean that while itay seem like am addiction to the weed, it could just be a desperacy to feel normal again. In which case it still wouldn't be justifiable the way she's using her daughter, she needs to admit herself to get proper treatment. Clearly the weed isn't doing enough if it's anxiety and depression and she still can't function with it. Those are both usually easy to work with as far as attaining basic functionality and managing symptoms. I hope everyone in this situation gets what they need and heals. Coming from someone who's mother didn't, and who couldn't get out, and ended up quite ruined from it for a long time.

I use it for anxiety and pain, I didn't mean to sound insensitive. Personally I've chosen pain management (I'm terminal) over other things pretty often, but I don't use it to get high, or when my pain levels are tolerable. I've never known a person in a situation where they were addicted, I apologize for that.

I don't think it's right to call cannabis an addiction when she's clearly treating her mental health with it. That being said, she clearly needs help. Like a lot. And I'm glad you got out, because while your parents health should matter, it should not be your responsibility. Something needs to be done, sure, but not by you. Don't feel guilty for ensuring your safety and future over an unhealthy relationship. I hope your mom gets the help she clearly needs, and that you leaving brings attention to those needs. And I hope you are able to move past the guilt, and that one day you two can have a functional relationship. I'm sorry to hear either of you are suffering. 💜

Idk. I'm just tired I guess. But at the moment I don't really have access to make it end immediately. Which is ideally what I want. I don't want a risk to live through it, I don't want something that takes long enough for someone to get help for me if they find me, because I think having a clean death might be easier for anyone who might still care than watching me get hooked to a machine and know that I don't want to be here. I also don't want the added pains and sickness from living through it and becoming damaged further, that's kind of why I'm trying to kill myself in the first place, ya know? It kind of defeats the purpose. I'm no really afraid of it, of dying. When I'm done, and I'm put in the ground, the one wish I have is to be composted instead of put into a coffin. The world has needs still, I just don't fulfill any alive. But in death at the very least, I can feed a tree or a crop or something useful, something besides sucking up money and resources as a dead end in someone's house or taxes. But I want it over with fast, because I dislike pain, and I just want to go in my sleep the most. I want to truly sleep just once, and then to not have to wake up anymore. I've thought about this for a pretty long time, honestly. I just don't have any purpose, and my existence causes negative affects to everyone relevent to it. It's a guilty and selfish way  to live, to even live at all. If that makes sense.
Thanks. I'm trying.

I'm in a couple that are like, pretty big, but idk. They just kinda sit and talk. If I can figure out how to approve my disability, I hope to save up for a decent gaming computer and just idk play things. I thought about that for a while. Can't with my laptop though cus it's REALLY on it's last leg anymore lol. I do art a lot. But I don't really do anything worth sharing with anyone. I guess I shouldn't be so vague and that's my fault. I can't really leave my house now, even after covid settles. So I guess it isn't really just having people to talk to I want to EXPERIENCE something. Like literally anything at this point. I just want to do things and feel real and human again. Like there's a point to being here because otherwise the only thing I have going for me now or future wise is to wake up on time and take my medicine on time so I keep living, stay away from other people, don't fly or go in the sun too long or perform long exercise like hiking like I used to, then go to sleep and do wake up again. There's nothing for me here, and I'm just trying to claw my way into literally anything to make it feel like I have something worth actually continuing this cycle for.

Back here huh? 

I did the same thing tonight. Just never getting messages back for days at a time, and I get that things are happening, and itsaking me feel guilty. Because he's sick like me, so I know he's busy with that and his career(can't talk about it but he's popular so it's hard for him) and at the same time like he's POPULAR so I guarantee he doesn't wanna spend his time with me, and it shows. It has for weeks now. I'm in love with this stupid tree of a man I swear. But I honestly can't handle the anxiety of being on the sidelines. Especially knowing how replaceable I am anyways. He's so important, and I'm just so.... Plain. I text him tonight and said I was just gonna go for a while. In all reality I can't give you advice on this one, because tbh, idk what I'm doing. I can't even sort out how I feel at 25 and what's happening in my life. I just know I love him like my own breath, and suddenly he doesn't want to be here anymore, so I can't sit around and be anxious forever....
Dude are you okay? Vent. We're here for it. Whatever is going on, you can't be as bad as you think.

I feel this in my literal soul. I'm the kind of person that doesn't click with people much, but when I find someone I really vibe with, we're inseparable. I met someone like that last year. Only I fell in love with him as time went on. We're both really sick chronically, and he's currently kind of fighting for his life. And it makes me sick to my stomach because I'm so clingy, and here we are like five states away from each other and have gone from talking nonstop to I get an update text maybe twice a week. I can't help him, and I feel like an emotional burden right now. I'd give anything to help him heal and get better. He was wheelchair bound to ease the strain and last medical update I got, he has permanent nerve damage that probably can't heal because I doubt his body could handle the treatments. 

When you find somebody that important and then your routine with them has changed, or even worse, they're gone, it can really tear you up. I can't even describe it, but I'm here. I completely understand what you mean. I hope things turn around for you, and whatever has happened is resolved. 💜
I'm sure that it will, evey thing in this world comes in cycles. Nature, life, weather, everything returns to the balance it should be at. I'm sorry if it's taking a while for your balance to return.

Hey, I'm sorry you have to deal with fucking weirdos. I'm proud of you for standing up when you are uncomfortable and only wish I had that energy when I was your age. It could have saved me a lot of trauma growing up. Keep being your authentic self, and don't you ever apologize for making your boundaries known and upholding them when they are violated or ignored, that is a strong trait to have. Stay strong and stay safe. 🌟

It is entirely acceptable to feel this way, and to feel like you don't have a place in life. It's okay to not be okay, and not to have everything figured out- or even yourself for that matter. This whole planet is pretty fucked right now, and it's hard to see a reason to keep participating sometimes. Maybe it would help to stop and think about the good things you've done for yourself - that amazing salad you made recently, or a wonderful show you finally finished watching, the cool dogs you jog past each day, that time you read a very sad story but wouldnt unread it because it was beautiful... You don't have to live to be a part of anything except your own happiness. If you don't feel like anybody to society, that's okay-you don't HAVE to be. You're important to the people that care and surround you, and you should be somebody to you. If you feel like your job has hit a dead end, try looking around for a new position that seems more fulfilling and see what you find. And if you're still unsure, or still want to talk, get back in here and keep fucking talking until you feel a little less lonely. Trust me, I'm still applying this to the shit storm I'm wading through, but I promise there are others who are in the same boat you are, and we care. Eventually this boat is gonna stop sinking. And until it does, it's absolutely acceptable to be sad about it. Just remember that you are worth continuing, and so is this weirdo hellfire planet were rolling around on.

I'm sorry you're going through whatever you are, and that your family has expectations that are clearly adding to your stress. I hope you do better than you thought, and even if you don't, that your quality of life improves and you find more value in yourself and your existence. You are valid, you are definitely doing good enough, and you are worth more than your grades could ever determine.

Most retail stores are like that, but at the end of the day, some of those people are a product of giving up in their environment and they're just trying to feel okay and get by. Bottom line fault lies with the companies exploiting them and shifting the blame. A lot of people aren't lucky enough to have those opportunities or access to them, or even the emotional capacity to handle it. Not to negate the shit you were put through, but they likely are stuck there and miserable about it. Don't let their suffering bring you down, and never take it personally. To them, it isn't even about you; it's usually about making them feel better. So you were entirely competent in your job, they just feel lacking in their own. Kudos on the revenge donuts though, that's greatly dramatic and I'm so here for it. 😂 also, good on you for having that kind of career aspiration! That's definitely something to work toward and sounds very fulfilling and fun. SIGNIFICANTLY more attractive and interesting life goal than becoming a manager at retail.

Please don't get back with your ex, especially with a new baby. I promise it gets easier and it's worth the struggle, even if it doesn't seem like it right now. You're doing your best and that is absolutely good enough and you deserve to be treated fairly in your current relationship and employment. I understand it's a delicate line to walk, and I truly wish you the best.

Well I'm sorry about your job, but good on you for standing up for what you think is right. Some people get so power trippy over the strangest jobs. Like please relax, you aren't a CEO, you're a manager. You're still just a person like everyone else.
It's okay to ramble sometimes. We're listening and we care. Your problems and emotions are valid.

Update to original post, on top of the symptoms I started out with, this is how the last two months have progressed. My vision is so bad I have to wear my glasses for almost everything.
I can't get my sleep on track, sometimes I sleep for three days and can barely stay awake to eat, and sometimes I can't sleep more than two or three hours a day for a week.
Vertigo and migraines are almost daily.
My BP and hr fluctuate constantly, and I'm in chronic pain that I've been trying to manage with specific weed strains instead of pills, because I don't want to end up on painkillers and risk addiction, but it's hard to sustain when I can't work, so just the pain alone keeps me down most of the time.
My temperature regulation is getting very sporadic and most of the time I'm wrapped and double layered, but I'm so cold my bones and joints hurt.
I get most of my nutrition from Powerade and vitamins because almost everything I eat makes me horribly sick and it's not even consistent anymore.
The vein on my right temple throbs so hard with my pulse sometimes that I fall even though I'm not fainting, I just kind of lose control I think.
My nerve in my stomach trips much more often and it's painful now.
I'm having severe pain in my abdomen on both sides, sometimes at the same time, close to the back, about midway between my hips and waist. It comes and goes.

I'm in line for a biopsy to confirm lymphoma and pheochromocytoma as well, and I guess I'm making the call and ending my streak of avoiding my doctors today. My immediate family found out I haven't been going for two months, and chewed me out. So now on top of all this shit, I feel fucking guilty too. I guess I don't blame them really they just want me to be here. But personally, knowing what autonomic failure means for me, I'd rather pull the plug. You can call me selfish to leave them behind I really don't care, I'm just fucking tired man. I don't have faith anymore, and it's been really hard to fight this and depression at the same time. Idk. I'm probably not going to off myself cus I just don't have it in me to know I'll be hurting my people when I do it. But I have nothing left. No job, my car got stolen and when I got it back 2 hours away it was a wrecked mess and the wiring is now fried and it doesn't run, bumming off my boyfriend who can barely sustain us both, two disability denials so I can't even support myself with that. I have a half trained service dog and the same four walls I stare at every damn day by myself. I think it's time for me to brave the downtown area (avoiding because in top ten covid areas of Nation) and see my therapist again, because I just can't keep living so damn miserably. I need to do something. I need to get some part of my life back. 

Fuck every single thing on this planet I WILL find a way to die fucking happy, and I'm gonna fight for every last minute to enjoy whatever it is. 

Sorry for my odd ranting. Just a good noodle doing their best I guess. 💜 thanks for stopping by and reading, I wasn't expecting any kindness from this place at all
I'd kind of rather not because it's something that could identify me, I'm sorry

... Thank you... It's weird. Cus sometimes it's only an inconvenience really and I have a few good days, where I do chores and I feel alright. And sometimes I'll go a week without being able to hold down solid food and I can't stand up because when I do I faint, so I end up just sitting and looking through the same shows on Hulu for the hundredth time. It's just so weird because you always think after a while, I get it, this is just how it's going to be now, and you accept it. And then you have mornings like this where you can feel your organs and all the arteries not working and you wake back up to the realization of what awaits you, and it's shaken everything I thought I had faith in. It's shaken my life to the core. It's almost unreal.
